newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end mixed, erasing early gains.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end mixed, erasing early gains.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed mixed on Wednesday, as technical selling erased earlier price gains of distant contracts, local traders said.
Prices ranged from 10 yen lower to 140 yen higher, with the benchmark March 1998 contract down 10 yen at 16,360 yen per tonne. The day's volume was 50,955 lots.
Price gains on the Chicago market overnight generated buying from local investors at the opening, traders said.
"By early afternoon, some investors had conducted technical selling in distant months," a brokerage house trader said. "Soybean contract is more active now."
The spot May contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $3.02-1/4 per bushel at 0755 GMT, unchanged from Tuesday's close.
The spot May of the CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $8.41 per bushel at 0755 GMT, down from $8.42 at Tuesday's close.
